<TunableVariant type="None" name="min_water_depth" class="OptionalTunable" default="disabled" display="Min Water Depth" description="(float) If provided, each vertex of the test polygon along with its centroid will be tested to determine whether the ocean water at the test location is at least this deep. <TunableVariant type="None" name="user_level" class="OptionalTunable" default="disabled" display="User Level" description="Threshold test for the current user value of a career. If user_level is set without career then it will pass if any of their careers pass the threshold test. If set along with career then it will only pass if the specified career passes the threshold test for user level. The min and max for the user level are inclusive. So the Sim can have any career level that meets the following equation and it will pass. min <= current career level <= max." group="General">
